notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Changes:
-Added achievements
-Added a skill tree (button is under your artifacts)
-New resource: electric coil (can be obtained by killing cultists or by looting containers)
-New electric turret
-2 new turrets, that can be built without toolboxes (mortar and machinegun)
-New electric trap
-You can now slow time by pressing "E"
-You can disable hints by pressing "F1"

Fixes: 
-Crew is now getting morale by killing enemies
-You can rest even if sanitiy is 100
-Insanity is deal more damage
-Every turret is now much stronger
-Container's spawn rate is increased
-Corpses disappear faster

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Changes:
- New "SAFE" zone on the map. Take your time and build turrets, feed your crew and play blackjack. Hunger is not affect on crew there.
- Now instead of autosave you can save anywhere you want.
- You can skip intro by pressing spacebar

Fixes:
- Fixed instant "game over" on a new game.
- Ingame main menu is now fully working
- You can't fell off your ship anymore
- Upgrades on command menu changing when you press on another upgrade
- Main menu is now fully working

You can check detailed guide while i'm working on ingame tutorial: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?i..
